newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's Submicron to launch IPO in November.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Submicron to launch IPO in November.

text.p: Submicron Technology Plc, Thailand's first semiconductor wafer fabricator, will launch an initial public offering (IPO) of its shares next month, Somsak Uswachoke, the company's executive director, said on Wednesday.

Somsak said the Securities and Exchange Commission, the bourse's regulator, had already approved his company's application to float its common shares. Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc will act as financial advisor.
A company plant worth 24 billion baht ($960 million), is now under construction in Bangkok's nearby province of Cha Cherng Sao and due to start operation in June 1997.
Initial production is 2,000 wafers per week, increasing to 5,000 wafers a week by 1999, part of which will be for export, Somsak said.
